name: Sun Boat IV

seo.title: Sun Boat IV Nile Cruise | A&K Sanctuary Flagship
seo.description: Sun Boat IV, an A&K Sanctuary: 38 cabins, 76 guests, Art Deco interiors and a pool deck. Four-night Luxor to Aswan cruises both ways, with 2026 and 2027 fares.

tagline: The A&K flagship on the Nile: 38 cabins, a pool deck and four nights between Luxor and Aswan.
answer: Sun Boat IV is the flagship of A&K Sanctuary's Nile fleet: a 72 m, four-deck riverboat with 38 cabins and suites for 76 guests. She sails four-night cruises between Luxor and Aswan in both directions, with an Egyptologist ashore. Children from 10 are welcome. She suits first-time Egypt travellers who want a proper pool deck and fixed, well-run days.
facts: 38 (34 Standard Cabins, 2 Presidential Suites, 2 Royal Suites)

overview: Sun Boat IV is the flagship of A&K Sanctuary on the Nile. She is 72 m long over four decks, with 38 cabins and suites for 76 guests. The look is Art Deco with Egyptian detail: etched metal, ceramics, dark wood, patterned rugs and Egyptian cotton on the beds.

The sun deck is the reason most people book her: cabanas, daybeds, bar service and a turquoise-tiled pool that is heated in winter. Below are a lounge bar, a restaurant with an outdoor deck for barbecue lunches, a library, a massage room and a small gym.

She sails four nights between Luxor and Aswan in either direction. Excursions run twice a day with an Egyptologist: Karnak, Luxor Temple, the Valley of the Kings, Edfu, Kom Ombo and Philae, with a felucca sail at Aswan. Balloon flights, the spice market and a Nubian village cost extra.
why: Sun Boat IV is the Nile cruise we suggest when someone wants Egypt done properly in four nights without giving up a pool. She runs often, in both directions, so she fits around Cairo and the Red Sea rather than the other way round. Book a Main, Promenade or Bridge Deck cabin for floor-to-ceiling windows; Nile Deck cabins have smaller windows and lower fares.

days.title: Welcome in Aswan
days.summary: Board at A&K's private dock to a Zaffa procession. After lunch, a felucca sail around Elephantine Island, then Kitchener's Botanical Gardens and the Aga Khan Mausoleum.

days.title: Philae and Kom Ombo
days.summary: By motorboat to the Philae temples on Agilika Island and on to the granite quarries. Cruise to Kom Ombo for an evening at the temple of Sobek.

days.title: Edfu, then Luxor
days.summary: Morning at the Temple of Edfu, then sail to Luxor with an optional cookery class. Visit the Temple of Luxor and dress in galabeyas for Egyptian Night.

days.title: West Bank and Karnak
days.summary: The Valley of the Kings, the Valley of the Queens, the Temple of Hatshepsut and the Colossi of Memnon, then the Temple of Karnak. Farewell gala dinner.

days.title: Welcome in Luxor
days.summary: Board at A&K's private dock to a Zaffa procession. After lunch, the East Bank with your Egyptologist: the Temple of Luxor and the Temple of Karnak.

days.title: Valley of the Kings, then Esna
days.summary: The Valley of the Kings, the Valley of the Queens, the Temple of Hatshepsut and the Colossi of Memnon. Cruise to Esna over lunch.

days.title: Edfu and Kom Ombo
days.summary: Morning at the Temple of Edfu, then sail to Kom Ombo with an optional cookery class. Evening at the Temple of Kom Ombo and Egyptian Night on board.

days.title: Philae and Elephantine
days.summary: By motorboat to Philae and the granite quarries. After lunch, a felucca sail around Elephantine Island, Kitchener's Botanical Gardens and the Aga Khan Mausoleum. Gala dinner.

faqs: How long is a Sun Boat IV cruise?
Four nights. She sails Luxor to Aswan or Aswan to Luxor; you board at a private dock after a short transfer from either airport.
How many cabins and guests does Sun Boat IV take?
38 cabins and suites for up to 76 guests: 34 Standard Cabins, two Presidential Suites and two Royal Suites.
Is Luxor to Aswan or Aswan to Luxor better?

The sites are the same. Choose by flights: Luxor is about an hour from Cairo, Aswan about an hour and a half. Upstream from Luxor ends with Philae and a felucca; downstream ends with the Valley of the Kings and Karnak.
Which Sun Boat IV cabin should I book?

Main, Promenade or Bridge Deck Standard Cabins have floor-to-ceiling windows. Nile Deck cabins have smaller windows and are the only ones that take a third bed. The two Royal Suites have private balconies.
Does Sun Boat IV have a pool?
Yes. The sun deck has a turquoise-tiled plunge pool, heated in winter, with cabanas, daybeds and bar service.
Can children sail on Sun Boat IV?
Children aged 10 and over are welcome, and under-15s share a cabin with an adult.
What does a Sun Boat IV cruise include?
All meals, water, tea and coffee at meals, juices at breakfast, afternoon tea, and guided excursions with transport and entrance fees. Drinks, flights, spa treatments and gratuities are extra.
What is the dress code on board?
Casual by day and smart casual at dinner. A&K asks that shorts and T-shirts are not worn at dinner.
